== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The Sandvipers are a sect of warriors characterized by their use of toxic, corrosive, and acidic powers. Their unique [[madra]] is derived from toxins and poisons, a [[Path]] that originated in the swamps as an adaptation to the corruption found within the [[Desolate Wilds|Wilds]]. To manage the lethal nature of their own abilities, members utilize a technique known as the [[Bloodforged Iron body]] and must consume the blood of a [[sandviper]] to mitigate organ damage caused by their venom. Many members possess serpent-like parasites or [[Remnants]] attached to their bodies, such as the [[Goldsign]], which can hiss or act as a warning. The group is often depicted wearing furs and animal hides, such as those from bear-like creatures. While some members live in simple huts made of scavenged materials, their leadership resides in a large, multi-peaked red tent. The sect is led by [[Sandviper Gokren|Gokren]], a wiry man who carries spears and wears snake skin. Individual members vary in temperament; some are described as nervous or fearful, while others are competent hunters and escorts. Their combat style frequently involves acid-green energy manifested as javelins, needles, or blades capable of melting through solid objects like wood.}}

== Soulsmith ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|The Sandvipers are a tenacious group belonging to the [[Sandviper sect]] that holds a corner of the [[Five Factions Alliance]] territory. As allies of [[Jai Sen]], they are seen at the gate and may have arrived via the [[Ruins]], often appearing in blood-spattered furs. This group, led by a young chief, utilizes [[scripted constructs]] for mining and employs captured prisoners—often those who have lost duels or cannot repay debts—to gather [[scales]]. They use [[Iron|iron]] and scripted collars to restrain these prisoners, whom they subject to specific techniques using insidious [[madra]] that can dissolve living flesh like acid. While [[Fisher Gesha|Gesha]] considers them cowards, the Sandvipers utilize [[Ruler techniques]] to produce paralyzing gases and use the [[Bloodforged Iron body]] to combat their own toxins. The natural [[sacred beasts]] themselves possess tan, bright carapaces, serpentine heads, centipede legs, and miniature [[Remnants]] attached to their arms.}}

== Blackflame ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|The Sandvipers are fur-clad veterans of [[Sandviper Gokren|Gokren]]'s sect who travel using flying constructs or [[Thousand-Mile Cloud]] mounts. After their scouts spotted [[Arelius family|Arelius]] banners, the group gathered to watch the white spear and even intervened in battle using acid-green javelins. While their wagons were seen moving through the [[Desolate Wilds]], some members stayed behind with [[Jai Long]] to care for [[Jai Chen]]. Associated closely with [[Jai Long]] and [[Sandviper Gokren|Gokren]], these warriors seek to capture [[Remnants]] for consumption while waging a guerilla war against the [[Jai clan]].}}
